newsitem.title: FRANCE: Israel's Netanyahu denies will cut short tour.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Netanyahu denies will cut short tour.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu denied on Thursday that he was planning to cut short a European tour and return home because of bloody clashes between Palestinians and Israeli troops.
"The reports that he is coming home early are without foundation," a spokesman for Netanyahu told reporters accompanying the prime minister.
He was speaking shortly before Netanyahu's plane was due leave from Paris for Germany on the final day of the Israeli leader's European trip.
In Washington, a State Department spokesman had said he believed Netanyahu intended to curtail his tour because of the violence, in which seven Arabs died on Wednesday.

The Israeli prime minister, who has visited Britain and France on his tour, was due to visit the former Nazi concentration camp at Bergen-Belsen in Germany before going to Bonn for talks with Chancellor Helmut Kohl.
He was due to leave for Israel on Thursday evening.
